body: Put your lovely offering or message or YT Link down below 💜
Please remember to submit only once.

After submitting, a small popup will appear at the top of the page That you have submitted , Once you click wait for that message to pop up. Depending on speed of Internet it will take time but clicking once it will give Success OR an error!
Once that’s done, click “Head to Basement Party”
I really hope you all enjoy my little surprise for Cutie Patootie Mirai 💜

nova-community.title: Hello Stars
body: This is message from nova's best, awesome and most Loyal Dog WOOF WOOF!

Nova is our little baby doing her best to be the best vtuber and trying everyday to be herself and stay happy. I want to thank you all for being the best community people for her and loving her as you do! She is happy and enjoying every stream because of you guys. You guys are best for being there for her!

Phantom-Card.title: NOBA, WOOF WOOF!
body: HAPPY BIRTHDAY NOBA! Its been almost 2 years since I met you and I feel ever since I met you I got a second family I can always rely on who accepted me for who I am

You are my Oshi you know why? Because why not, you are cool person, you know how your life has been and honestly if I was in your place I would be depressed and would not been this happy or good. But you everyday live so well, happy everytime and same nova even with the pains you get. For me that's very admirable

Thank you for making me part of your life and one of your mods, its one of the best things that happened to me in last 2 years and I loved every part of it, the dramas , the fun , the friendships everything. Thank you!
Once again , Happy Borthday nova, May we be good friends and family as long as we live and I shall stay your loyal Pet dog!
